name: fworder
description: Print order of firewall rule properties (filter and nat) when many are combined.
steps: /ip firewall filter add chain=forward action=drop comment=big place-before=0 src-address-list=a dst-address-list=b in-interface-list=WAN out-interface-list=WAN in-interface=ether1 out-interface=ether2 src-address=1.1.1.1 dst-address=2.2.2.2 src-port=1000 dst-port=2000 protocol=tcp connection-state=new connection-nat-state=dstnat tcp-flags=syn connection-limit=10,32 limit=5,5 packet-mark=x connection-mark=y routing-mark=main src-mac-address=00:11:22:33:44:55 dscp=4 ttl=equal:64 nth=2,1 random=10 in-bridge-port=ether1 out-bridge-port=ether1 content=abc packet-size=100-200 ipsec-policy=in,ipsec fragment=yes time=1h-2h,mon dst-limit=5,5,dst-address/1m src-address-type=local dst-address-type=local ingress-priority=1 per-connection-classifier=both-addresses:2/0 ipv4-options=any psd=21,3s,3,1 hotspot=auth log=yes log-prefix=abc

/ip firewall nat add chain=dstnat action=dst-nat comment=big to-addresses=10.0.0.1 to-ports=80 src-address-list=a dst-address-list=b in-interface-list=WAN in-interface=ether1 src-address=1.1.1.1 dst-address=2.2.2.2 src-port=1000 dst-port=2000 protocol=tcp connection-state=new dscp=4 packet-mark=x connection-mark=y routing-mark=main src-address-type=local dst-address-type=local log=yes log-prefix=abc
/ip firewall filter add chain=forward action=accept protocol=udp dst-port=53 src-address=10.0.0.0/24 comment=x connection-state=new in-interface=ether1 disabled=yes
